job_wall_definition: From immediately before model open through final grading and recording; excludes dataset preparation before the interpreter starts.
call_wall_definition: MLPL decoding call, including prefill, native forward and token selection; excludes final text decoding, grading and file writes.
device_memory_definition: Maximum of 1094 device-wide nvidia-smi samples, including desktop use; sampling approximately every two seconds can miss short peaks.
host_memory_definition: Maximum observed VmHWM of the MLPL/native-provider process; CPU memory, separate from VRAM.
saved_request_and_primary_grade_replay: passed for all 50 attempts using unchanged MLPL extraction and verification; no grade changes
qualitative_review: book-author-v2-review.jsonl; selected examples, not exhaustive proof of reasoning steps
limitations: first-ten demonstration, not a full 500-case or fresh holdout claim
